desc.ian_image_library:title: Chloroscombrus chrysurus (Atlantic Bumper)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: The Atlantic Bumper is a game fish found from Massachusetts to Florida in the Western Atlantic Ocean. They eat smaller fish, cephalopods, and zooplankton.
